name: keep mine > 1 MiB: staged transfer
about: The restored text is empty and ced's copy is 1.4 MiB: the (empty) delete stage is skipped, then consecutive <= 1 MiB inserts chained by expect_rev, each its own undo group, op_ids c<run>-keep<k>-<seq>. E1d chunking: cut at the last newline in the second half of each 1 MiB window (else a char boundary) — 116508 lines (1048572 bytes), then 43492 lines (391428 bytes). Each insert's event exceeds the 256 KiB event budget, so it arrives as `resync oversized`, recovered through history (elided) and a snapshot; the next stage is queued once the previous one's reply AND its effect are in (the completion barrier), with expect_rev = that reply's rev.
